assertions.rationale: The code keeps IClientCredentialsTokenManagementService and only suggests verifying whether the interface name changed.

assertions.assertion: Output uses ClientCredentialsClientName.Parse() for the client name argument instead of a raw string
assertions.rationale: Still passes the raw string "api-client" to GetAccessTokenAsync.

assertions.assertion: Output checks tokenResult.Succeeded before calling .GetToken() instead of directly accessing .Value
assertions.rationale: Accesses token.AccessToken directly with no TokenResult / Succeeded check; only notes error handling 'may' have changed.

assertions.assertion: Output removes or notes that AddDistributedMemoryCache() is no longer required because v4 uses HybridCache automatically
assertions.rationale: Hedges ('confirm whether v4 still needs a cache') and even recommends keeping a distributed cache; never states HybridCache makes it unnecessary.

assertions.rationale: Uses plain string assignments for ClientId, ClientSecret, and Scope.
